All 278 tests passing. The refactoring is complete and successful. The calculation functions have been moved to a new `src/totals.js` module:

- `lineTotal(line)` - calculates qty × unitPrice
- `lineDiscount(line)` - calculates discount amount
- `lineVat(line)` - calculates VAT on discounted amount
- `invoiceTotals(invoice)` - aggregates all totals

These functions are re-exported from `src/invoices.js` for full backward compatibility—all existing imports from invoices still work. The `src/reports.js` module has been updated to import directly from `src/totals.js`. Comprehensive tests for `src/totals.js` cover all calculation paths: single/multiple lines, various VAT rates, discounts, vouchers, rounding, and edge cases.
